BackstoryDef.title: moon sugar picker
BackstoryDef.description: Every harvest, [PAWN_nameDef] cut cane in the Pelletine fields until both hands were sticky to the wrist. The overseers docked pay for licking fingers, and nobody ever lost more pay than [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: yarn royal
BackstoryDef.description: In one Senchal alley, [PAWN_nameDef] ruled a court of street cubs from a throne of stolen wool. The decrees were absurd and the punishments involved a lot of pouncing, but everyone showed up.

BackstoryDef.title: kitchen slave
BackstoryDef.description: Sold to a Dunmer household before [PAWN_pronoun] could count, [PAWN_nameDef] learned every spice in the pantry by smell. [PAWN_pronoun] also learned which ones an unkind master could not taste.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] slipped the collar on a road through Stonefalls and walked west for two months. Anyone who has done that does not trust a locked door afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: Rimmen street cub
BackstoryDef.description: The markets of Rimmen raised [PAWN_nameDef] between the stalls. By eight, [PAWN_pronoun] could tell a Colovian coin from a shaved one by the sound it made hitting the ground.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan cub
BackstoryDef.description: The clan's senche knew [PAWN_nameDef] by scent before anybody thought to teach [PAWN_objective] a trade. [PAWN_pronoun] slept on their flanks between Dune and Riverhold for most of ten years.

BackstoryDef.title: fennec fox chaser
BackstoryDef.description: There was one fennec on the Anequina flats that [PAWN_nameDef] swore could talk. It never said anything useful, but the years of chasing it built a very good pair of legs.

BackstoryDef.title: senche race groom
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] brushed racing senche at Orcrest for a copper a day, and bet that copper every day. The clan got tired of covering the losses and put [PAWN_objective] to shoveling.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter's whelp
BackstoryDef.description: Before sunrise the hunters took [PAWN_nameDef] out into the Tenmar and left [PAWN_objective] there to find the way back. It only took a few tries before [PAWN_pronoun] brought a rabbit along too.

BackstoryDef.title: Thalmor ward
BackstoryDef.description: The Dominion offered to school a few clever Khajiiti children in Alinor. [PAWN_nameDef] came home with beautiful handwriting and a very clear idea of what the Altmer think of cats.

BackstoryDef.title: temple foundling
BackstoryDef.description: Left on the steps of a shrine to Khenarthi during a sandstorm, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up carrying water for moon priests. They said the wind had delivered [PAWN_objective], which seemed unfair to the wind.

BackstoryDef.title: cub of a scribe
BackstoryDef.description: Clan contracts in Corinthe were written by [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother and copied by [PAWN_nameDef]. A misplaced word once cost someone a herd of guar, and that lesson only needed teaching once.

BackstoryDef.title: tribal medic's helper
BackstoryDef.description: The clan medic had bad knees and [PAWN_nameDef] had good ones. So [PAWN_pronoun] climbed for the herbs, boiled the rags and saw more of the insides of people than most adults ever do.

BackstoryDef.title: curious cub
BackstoryDef.description: No trap, lock or hinge in the village survived [PAWN_nameDef]'s curiosity. A few of them worked better afterward, which was the only reason [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed to keep doing it.

BackstoryDef.title: scaredy-cub
BackstoryDef.description: Thunder sent [PAWN_nameDef] under the wagon. So did loud uncles and most birds. The clan teased [PAWN_objective] for years, then noticed that [PAWN_pronoun] was the one who always spotted trouble first.

BackstoryDef.title: cub of M'aiq
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] told everyone that [PAWN_possessive] father was M'aiq the Liar. The story varied, and that was fairly good evidence for it.

BackstoryDef.title: child racer
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in the canyon villages could outrun [PAWN_nameDef] on foot, and [PAWN_pronoun] made sure everyone knew it. The first time [PAWN_pronoun] lost, [PAWN_pronoun] did not speak for a week.

BackstoryDef.title: bone collector
BackstoryDef.description: Old bones wash out of the Scar after every rain. [PAWN_nameDef] gathered them, carved them and sold them to Imperial visitors as dragon teeth, which most of them were not.

BackstoryDef.title: Whispering Claw novice
BackstoryDef.description: Sent to the monastery at seven, [PAWN_nameDef] spent two years sweeping before anyone showed [PAWN_objective] a stance. The sweeping, [PAWN_pronoun] was later told, had been the stance.

BackstoryDef.title: Desert Rain novice
BackstoryDef.description: The Desert Rain monks teach stillness first. [PAWN_nameDef] once sat on a dune through a whole day and a night to prove a point, and could not remember what the point had been.

BackstoryDef.title: Goutfang novice
BackstoryDef.description: At the Goutfang school [PAWN_nameDef] learned that a fist should find the place it will hurt most. [PAWN_pronoun] also learned where those places are, by having them found.

BackstoryDef.title: Riverhold ferry cub
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] poled a ferry across the Xylo for strangers' coin, soaking wet and furious most days. Khajiit hate the water, but they do love getting paid.

BackstoryDef.title: skooma runner
BackstoryDef.description: Someone needed to take small packets across Senchal without being noticed, and a skinny cub was perfect. [PAWN_nameDef] knew every roof in the harbor district by the time [PAWN_pronoun] was ten.

BackstoryDef.title: orphan of the Knahaten Flu
BackstoryDef.description: The flu came through when [PAWN_nameDef] was small and left [PAWN_objective] the last one in the house. Neighbors shared what they had, which was not much, and nobody talks about that year.

BackstoryDef.title: pedlar's cub
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with the Bandaari, who taught [PAWN_objective] that anything left unattended has been given to you. A magistrate in Rimmen explained the other view of it.

BackstoryDef.title: moon-watcher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept a knotted cord that recorded every phase of Jone and Jode for six years. The moon priests were impressed, right up until [PAWN_pronoun] corrected them.

BackstoryDef.title: well digger's cub
BackstoryDef.description: In Anequina, water is wealth and the people who find it are owed a great deal. [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood at the bottom of a rope, listening to wet rock.

BackstoryDef.title: tanner's cub
BackstoryDef.description: The whole family smelled of the vats and the whole village said so. [PAWN_nameDef] can still judge a hide in the dark with one paw, and still cannot smell much of anything.

BackstoryDef.title: sugar-bakery cub
BackstoryDef.description: A Khajiiti bakery runs on moon sugar and gossip. [PAWN_nameDef] learned both behind the counter in Torval, and put on a lot of weight doing it.

BackstoryDef.title: shrine bell ringer
BackstoryDef.description: Twice each night, [PAWN_nameDef] climbed the shrine tower to ring in the moons. Being late brought a stern lecture about the Lunar Lattice, and being asleep brought a colder one.

BackstoryDef.title: storm cub
BackstoryDef.description: Born in the middle of a Pelletine monsoon, [PAWN_nameDef] was told it marked [PAWN_objective] for something. Nothing ever came of that, but [PAWN_pronoun] kept an excellent eye on the sky.

BackstoryDef.title: courier's cub
BackstoryDef.description: Clan elders are always sending messages to other clan elders, and few of them want anything written down. [PAWN_nameDef] could carry an insult across Elsweyr word for word.

BackstoryDef.title: war cub
BackstoryDef.description: The Five Companions War was over by then, but nobody had told [PAWN_nameDef]'s village. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up with a wooden spear and a real hatred of Colovians.

BackstoryDef.title: Bosmer's ward
BackstoryDef.description: A Wood Elf trader lost a wager and took [PAWN_nameDef] in as payment for the debt. The arrangement lasted nine years and included a great deal of very strange meat.

BackstoryDef.title: alley fighter
BackstoryDef.description: Dune's back streets settled most disputes with claws. [PAWN_nameDef] had both ears torn by twelve and was held in fine regard by the other children.

BackstoryDef.title: fisher's cub
BackstoryDef.description: Khajiit do not swim for pleasure, but somebody has to mend the nets at Senchal. [PAWN_nameDef] did that for years from a very safe distance above the waterline.

BackstoryDef.title: potter's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Clay from the Xylo banks took [PAWN_nameDef]'s paw prints on every jar. Customers stopped complaining once somebody started calling them a mark of quality.

BackstoryDef.title: hide-and-seek champion
BackstoryDef.description: One game with the village cubs lasted three days because [PAWN_nameDef] would not come out. By then the search had a religious feel to it, and [PAWN_pronoun] was quietly proud.

BackstoryDef.title: Mane's procession cub
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked in front of the Mane's litter one year, carrying incense. To this day, [PAWN_pronoun] brings it up within a minute of meeting anyone.

BackstoryDef.title: sand-glass cub
BackstoryDef.description: An old glassmaker in Dune sold bottles to skooma brewers and pretended not to know why. [PAWN_nameDef] blew those bottles, kept those secrets and burned most of [PAWN_possessive] whiskers.

BackstoryDef.title: Thrassian raid survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Sload slavers came ashore for three nights, and [PAWN_nameDef] spent them under a cistern lid. [PAWN_pronoun] does not much like the sea, or the smell of mud.

BackstoryDef.title: rooftop thief
BackstoryDef.description: Rajhin is said to have stolen the tattoo off an Emperor's neck. [PAWN_nameDef] started smaller, with laundry, and was doing very well before the fall.

BackstoryDef.title: goat herder's cub
BackstoryDef.description: The goats of the high Anequina scrub are worse than most people. [PAWN_nameDef] learned patience there, along with a number of words that the goats alone appreciated.

BackstoryDef.title: runt of the litter
BackstoryDef.description: Five siblings ate first. S'rendarr looks after runts, [PAWN_possessive] mother liked to say, and [PAWN_nameDef] noticed the god never brought any extra food.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan cook's helper
BackstoryDef.description: There is a right way to make saltrice on a moving wagon, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned it by getting it wrong in front of forty hungry traders.

BackstoryDef.title: lamp lighter
BackstoryDef.description: At dusk [PAWN_nameDef] lit every lamp on one long street in Corinthe. It was dull work, except that people say unwise things when they think only a cub is listening.

BackstoryDef.title: temple cat keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Yes, the shrine kept ordinary cats, and no, nobody found this funny. [PAWN_nameDef] fed them for years, and is firmly of the opinion that they are not related.

BackstoryDef.title: dragon shadow cub
BackstoryDef.description: A dragon crossed over [PAWN_nameDef]'s village once, flying very low, and did not stop. For the rest of [PAWN_possessive] childhood, the adults kept looking up.

BackstoryDef.title: storyteller's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed an old storyteller from fire to fire and learned the tales by heart. Later [PAWN_pronoun] learned to shift the endings around depending on who was paying.

BackstoryDef.title: ash-road refugee
BackstoryDef.description: The clan walked out of a burned valley with one wagon and every grandparent still alive. [PAWN_nameDef] was asked to count them every night, and always felt responsible.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragonguard initiate
BackstoryDef.description: The old order was gone, and Elsweyr had remembered why it wanted one. [PAWN_nameDef] took the oath in Senchal, trained under Sai Sahan's successors and spent years looking at the sky for the wrong reasons.

BackstoryDef.title: Whispering Claw adept
BackstoryDef.description: Students of the Whispering Claw learn to strike where a person's balance already wants to go. [PAWN_nameDef] once ended a tavern fight by nudging someone's elbow.

BackstoryDef.title: Goutfang brawler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] graduated from the Goutfang school with a broken nose and a professional's view of other people's joints. [PAWN_pronoun] charges double for rib work.

BackstoryDef.title: war monk
BackstoryDef.description: Monastery walls in Elsweyr are thick for a reason. [PAWN_nameDef] defended one for eleven years and kept to the ritual hours, even when the ritual hours fell in the middle of a siege.

BackstoryDef.title: assassin monk
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] belonged to an order that insisted it did not exist and could not be hired. Payment went to a shrine with no priest, and nobody was ever late with it.

BackstoryDef.title: Riverhold militia
BackstoryDef.description: During the Riverhold riots, [PAWN_nameDef] stood on a wall with a spear and an unclear idea of who the enemy was. [PAWN_pronoun] survived by assuming it was everyone.

BackstoryDef.title: Anequinan lancer
BackstoryDef.description: A Khajiit on a war senche is a frightening thing to meet. [PAWN_nameDef] rode the plains with a long lance, and considered the animal the smarter half of the arrangement.

BackstoryDef.title: desert scout
BackstoryDef.description: A scout on the Anequina flats learns to read old tracks in moving sand. [PAWN_nameDef] guided three armies through and got paid by one of them.

BackstoryDef.title: Pelletine marine
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody signs on as a marine out of love of water. [PAWN_nameDef] signed on to escape a debt, served on Senchal galleys and was seasick for six straight years.

BackstoryDef.title: sword-singer's rival
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went to Hammerfell to prove that Khajiiti blades were as good as any Redguard's. The results were mixed, and the stories are not.

BackstoryDef.title: bandit hunter
BackstoryDef.description: The clan mothers paid by the ear for Renrijra Krin. [PAWN_nameDef] brought in so many that they started checking whether the ears were real.

BackstoryDef.title: Renrijra deserter
BackstoryDef.description: The Renrijra Krin called themselves freedom fighters when [PAWN_nameDef] joined up. After a season of burning clan farmsteads, [PAWN_pronoun] left in the night and did not go back for [PAWN_possessive] pay.

BackstoryDef.title: Renrijra cutthroat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never cared whether the Krin was fighting for Elsweyr, as long as the caravans kept coming. [PAWN_pronoun] has left four names behind, in four provinces, in four separate hurries.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan guard
BackstoryDef.description: Bandaari caravans travel with more guards than goods. [PAWN_nameDef] walked beside the wagons for fifteen years, and could tell a raider from a beggar at half a mile.

BackstoryDef.title: Great War veteran
BackstoryDef.description: Elsweyr sent soldiers north when the Dominion asked, and the Dominion did not ask politely. [PAWN_nameDef] fought at the Imperial City, and has mostly refused to talk about it.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial auxiliary
BackstoryDef.description: The Legion is happy to take Khajiiti scouts, as long as they eat at a different table. [PAWN_nameDef] served twenty years, saved a general, and was paid in a sealed letter of thanks.

BackstoryDef.title: Thalmor gatekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: Under the treaty, Khajiit may guard the Dominion's gates at the Dominion's pleasure. [PAWN_nameDef] stood in a very fine uniform at Rimmen and was never once given a key.

BackstoryDef.title: moon-blade duelist
BackstoryDef.description: Khajiiti duels take place by moonlight and are done over before most spectators have found their seats. [PAWN_nameDef] fought nineteen of them. [PAWN_pronoun] says the first eighteen were misunderstandings.

BackstoryDef.title: siege sapper
BackstoryDef.description: When a wall in the Five Companions War needed to come down, someone had to dig underneath it. [PAWN_nameDef] did that for years, and now prefers to sit near doors.

BackstoryDef.title: Tenmar archer
BackstoryDef.description: Tenmar forest is thick enough that an arrow rarely travels farther than a shout. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to shoot at noises, and is slightly embarrassed by how well that works.

BackstoryDef.title: skirmish captain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led a band of forty along the Colovian border, and brought back thirty-eight of them. In that line of work, those two are always remembered by name.

BackstoryDef.title: werelion hunter
BackstoryDef.description: A werelion leaves very specific damage, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned to spot it fast. [PAWN_pronoun] has silver in both boots, and very little patience for people who stay out late.

BackstoryDef.title: Dro-m'Athra slayer
BackstoryDef.description: Khajiit who walk the Dark Behind the World come back wrong, and somebody has to send them on again. [PAWN_nameDef] does this work, and does not sleep well on a moonless night.

BackstoryDef.title: harbor enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: In Senchal, the difference between a tax and a threat is who sends you. [PAWN_nameDef] collected for all sides, and never met a dockhand who needed a second visit.

BackstoryDef.title: Dune gate sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran the night watch at Dune, a duty consisting mainly of knowing which smugglers were on the list. [PAWN_pronoun] kept that list in [PAWN_possessive] head and kept [PAWN_possessive] head.

BackstoryDef.title: senche handler
BackstoryDef.description: Senche are people, and they will remind you of it. [PAWN_nameDef] served as a go-between for tiger-folk warriors and their officers, and was bitten only by the officers.

BackstoryDef.title: moon priest
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] read the Lunar Lattice for a clan in Pelletine, naming newborns and telling them what form they would take. Mothers argued with [PAWN_objective] about it, and the moons never did.

BackstoryDef.title: moon bishop's clerk
BackstoryDef.description: There are few things more political than a calendar. [PAWN_nameDef] kept a moon bishop's records for fifteen years, and could end a family's claim to a field by adjusting one date.

BackstoryDef.title: Mane's attendant
BackstoryDef.description: Only one Mane exists at a time, and nobody touches the braids without years of training. [PAWN_nameDef] had the training, and knows several things that would start a war.

BackstoryDef.title: spirit-speaker
BackstoryDef.description: The ancestors do not often speak clearly, in [PAWN_nameDef]'s experience. [PAWN_pronoun] charges by the visit, and gives a discount if they do not answer.

BackstoryDef.title: temple healer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served Khenarthi's shrine at Dune through two plague seasons, using spells where they worked and willow bark where they did not. The bark did more.

BackstoryDef.title: Khenarthi's wind-caller
BackstoryDef.description: Sailors at Senchal pay well for a fair wind. [PAWN_nameDef] sold them a prayer and a look at the sky, and was right often enough to stay in business.

BackstoryDef.title: College dropout
BackstoryDef.description: The College of Winterhold takes anyone who can pay and pass, and [PAWN_nameDef] managed one of those. Three years in the snow taught [PAWN_objective] some destruction magic and how much [PAWN_pronoun] hates the cold.

BackstoryDef.title: desert illusionist
BackstoryDef.description: A traveling show out of Rimmen paid [PAWN_nameDef] to conjure phantom senche for the crowds. A second, quieter line of business involved phantom coins.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: A wagon full of goods sells for more if a few of them glow. [PAWN_nameDef] put honest enchantments on some, and a good story on the rest.

BackstoryDef.title: sugar alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: Moon sugar has medical uses. [PAWN_nameDef] will tell you this at length, while carefully keeping [PAWN_possessive] notes on the other uses out of sight.

BackstoryDef.title: dream reader
BackstoryDef.description: In Corinthe, [PAWN_nameDef] sold interpretations of dreams from a tent with a very good lock. Regular customers tended to have the kind of dreams that benefit from privacy.

BackstoryDef.title: Rajhin's acolyte
BackstoryDef.description: The god of thieves has few proper priests. [PAWN_nameDef] was one, in a shrine that moved every time anyone found it, and collected offerings without asking first.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan Mother's seer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sat at a clan mother's elbow, reading omens that always somehow favored the clan mother. [PAWN_pronoun] believes every one of them was true anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: moon-dancer
BackstoryDef.description: The Two-Moons Dance is said to walk the path between Ahnurr and Fadomai. [PAWN_nameDef] performed it at festivals in full, and once in a dry well to get out of a debt.

BackstoryDef.title: Lunar Lattice scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent twenty years in a tower at Torval trying to prove the Lattice could be mapped. [PAWN_pronoun] nearly finished the proof, and then the moons disappeared for two years and ruined the numbers.

BackstoryDef.title: exorcist of the Dark Behind
BackstoryDef.description: Lost spirits gather where a Khajiit has died badly. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the old battlefields to see them home, and has stopped being surprised by what follows [PAWN_objective] back.

BackstoryDef.title: Psijic correspondent
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once wrote a letter to Artaeum asking about moon magic. Years later a reply came, correcting [PAWN_possessive] grammar and answering a question [PAWN_pronoun] had not yet asked.

BackstoryDef.title: poison-tongue herbalist
BackstoryDef.description: Most of the plants in the Tenmar want to kill you, and the rest are waiting for their chance. [PAWN_nameDef] catalogued them by smell, which cost [PAWN_objective] a few years of [PAWN_possessive] life.

BackstoryDef.title: shrine restorer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] repaired Alkosh's statues along the Ne Quin-al road, working from old sketches and strong opinions. Several of them now look a good deal like [PAWN_possessive] uncle.

BackstoryDef.title: shadow-walker
BackstoryDef.description: By going to a place in the Scar where the moons never shine, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to step sideways from the light. [PAWN_pronoun] says it was worth it, and still flinches at dusk.

BackstoryDef.title: moon sugar farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Rows of cane, a hard overseer and a harvest worth more than the people cutting it: [PAWN_nameDef] did this for most of [PAWN_possessive] life, then one morning simply kept walking.

BackstoryDef.title: skooma addict
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] will tell you exactly when it stopped being a choice. [PAWN_pronoun] can no longer remember very much else about those years, except for how the bottles looked in the sun.

BackstoryDef.title: recovering addict
BackstoryDef.description: It has been a long time since [PAWN_nameDef] last touched skooma, and [PAWN_pronoun] can tell you the exact number of days. Others who are trying to quit tend to find [PAWN_objective] sooner or later.

BackstoryDef.title: renowned chef
BackstoryDef.description: A Khajiiti saying holds that the food is the only honest thing a stranger offers. [PAWN_nameDef] once fed a Dominion ambassador so well that he lost the trade dispute and thanked [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: freed slave
BackstoryDef.description: The Argonians broke the collar in Morrowind, and [PAWN_nameDef] walked home across half a continent. [PAWN_pronoun] found the house, but not the family, and did not stay.

BackstoryDef.title: odd artist
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody can say what the paintings are of. [PAWN_nameDef] says they are of the Lunar Lattice, seen from behind. Some collectors in Daggerfall paid a great deal for them.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering trader
BackstoryDef.description: Everything has a price and every price is a beginning. [PAWN_nameDef] has sold rope to sailors, sand to Redguards and a very old cat to a Thalmor justiciar.

BackstoryDef.title: cursed trader
BackstoryDef.description: An old woman in Rimmen said no sale of [PAWN_nameDef]'s would ever turn out well. All sales since have been final, which [PAWN_pronoun] considers a sensible policy regardless.

BackstoryDef.title: Bandaari pedlar
BackstoryDef.description: By Bandaari reckoning, anything left behind belongs to whoever picks it up, and [PAWN_nameDef] can make a person's belongings seem left behind with very little effort.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering liar
BackstoryDef.description: This one has met the Emperor, wrestled a dragon, and owns a very fine castle back home. [PAWN_nameDef] will happily tell you all about it, and each visit will be a different castle.

BackstoryDef.title: Rimmen moneylender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lent gold at rates that were legal on paper, using contracts that were almost readable. People stopped speaking to [PAWN_objective], but they did not stop borrowing.

BackstoryDef.title: saltrice baker
BackstoryDef.description: Up before the moons went down and asleep by midday, [PAWN_nameDef] fed one Torval neighborhood for twenty years. [PAWN_pronoun] knows more about those families than their priest does.

BackstoryDef.title: clan accountant
BackstoryDef.description: Sixteen kingdoms is a lot of bookkeeping. [PAWN_nameDef] balanced the ledgers for one small clan that was somehow always at war with its own cousins.

BackstoryDef.title: bath attendant
BackstoryDef.description: Khajiit do not bathe in water if they can help it. [PAWN_nameDef] ran a sand bath in Corinthe where the wealthy came to be scrubbed, and to talk freely with their eyes closed.

BackstoryDef.title: jeweler of Torval
BackstoryDef.description: Jewelers in Torval say a Khajiit's rings tell you who has been paying them. [PAWN_nameDef] made the rings, and has always been careful about what those rings said.

BackstoryDef.title: tailor to the clans
BackstoryDef.description: A proper tail-slit needs to fit perfectly, or the whole outfit hangs wrong. [PAWN_nameDef] dressed three generations of clan mothers and has opinions about every one of them.

BackstoryDef.title: muleteer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove guar and mules over the Dragontail passes, in all weather, for whoever was paying. [PAWN_pronoun] still talks to animals more than to people, and they listen better.

BackstoryDef.title: well keeper
BackstoryDef.description: In a dry year, whoever keeps the well runs the village. [PAWN_nameDef] took the job seriously, and was never once short of invitations to dinner.

BackstoryDef.title: smuggler
BackstoryDef.description: The cane had to get across the border somehow. [PAWN_nameDef] owned a wagon with a false bottom, a very clean set of papers, and an expression of permanent mild surprise.

BackstoryDef.title: fence
BackstoryDef.description: Whatever you have, [PAWN_nameDef] has never seen it before and does not want to know. [PAWN_pronoun] will give you a third of what it is worth and a very warm handshake.

BackstoryDef.title: cat burglar
BackstoryDef.description: Yes, that is what they call it, and no, [PAWN_nameDef] does not think it is funny. [PAWN_pronoun] has lifted a Count's seal, a bishop's wig and an entire front door.

BackstoryDef.title: gem cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Gems from the Scar need a steady paw and a suspicious mind. [PAWN_nameDef] has cut sapphires for kings, and glass for people who thought they were kings.

BackstoryDef.title: hospice keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Near the sugar fields, there is always somebody at the end of a long habit. [PAWN_nameDef] kept a few beds for them, and took no payment beyond whatever they left behind.

BackstoryDef.title: road musician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] played a three-stringed lute from Riverhold to Rimmen and back. The caravans paid in food, the taverns in coin and the Renrijra Krin, on one occasion, by not doing anything.

BackstoryDef.title: grave-tender
BackstoryDef.description: Burying someone badly can send them into the Sands Behind the Stars, so [PAWN_nameDef] saw to it that nobody got buried badly. It was a calm job, and very few customers complained.

BackstoryDef.title: bazaar scribe
BackstoryDef.description: For a coin, [PAWN_nameDef] would write a love letter. For two coins, [PAWN_pronoun] would write the angry response. Business was very good when both parties came to the same stall.

BackstoryDef.title: tiger-tamer's assistant
BackstoryDef.description: A traveling show paid [PAWN_nameDef] to put [PAWN_possessive] head inside a tiger's mouth, on the grounds that it was a professional courtesy. The tiger retired before [PAWN_pronoun] did.

BackstoryDef.title: architect of the Mane's stair
BackstoryDef.description: It took [PAWN_nameDef] eleven years to build one staircase at the Mane's summer palace. The Mane only used it twice, but both times [PAWN_pronoun] stood at the bottom and watched.

BackstoryDef.title: mud-brick mason
BackstoryDef.description: Dune is made of mud brick, and so is most of what it will be rebuilt from. [PAWN_nameDef] has put up the same wall four times and has never once been paid for the first three.

BackstoryDef.title: sugar tax assessor
BackstoryDef.description: No one is ever pleased to see the assessor. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the Pelletine fields for ten years with a ledger, a guard and a strict habit of never eating anything offered to [PAWN_objective].
